mechanics.candidate_probe: Evaluate fold=0 and fold=1, convert to UTC, round-trip to the same zone and retain only readings that reproduce the reported naive wall time.
mechanics.unique_dedup: Candidates are deduplicated by UTC instant.
mechanics.ordering: Legal candidates are sorted chronologically by UTC instant.
mechanics.reject_policy: Reject implicit single-winner selection; keep every legal candidate.
mechanics.earlier_policy: Select candidates[0], the chronologically earlier legal UTC reading / PEP-495 fold=0 in a fold.
mechanics.later_policy: Select candidates[-1], the chronologically later legal UTC reading / PEP-495 fold=1 in a fold.
mechanics.gap_policy: If no reading round-trips to the reported wall time, return NONEXISTENT with zero legal candidates.

provenance_repair.old_description: Return both UTC candidates and require an explicit choice.
provenance_repair.repaired_semantics: Reject implicit single-winner selection and return all legal UTC candidates; higher layers preserve the ambiguity as branches rather than inventing a winner.

transmission_impact.reason: Modern Python civil-time disambiguation semantics add no historical Ziwei/Bazi transmission edge.
